title: Cloud Network Azure ExpressRoute Gateway Down

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `azure:monitor:resource` events with `operationName="Microsoft.*Gateway Down"` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.13.5 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `azure:monitor:resource` traffic without `operationName="Microsoft.*Gateway Down"`. Confirm UC-4.13.5 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

description: UC-4.13.5 — Cloud Network Azure ExpressRoute Gateway Down: queries multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) `azure:monitor:resource` for `Microsoft.*Gateway Down` and returns actor, resource, and region context for availability review and change validation.
value: On multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), 'Cloud Network Azure ExpressRoute Gateway Down' highlights abnormal network flow patterns—reconnaissance, lateral movement, or blocked exfiltration that perimeter tools may not correlate across cloud segments. UC-4.13.5 drives high-priority availability alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=azure:monitor:resource.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud networking logs via provider TA with the modular input for `azure:monitor:resource`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.13.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `ResourceId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=azure:monitor:resource.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="azure:monitor:resource" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="azure:monitor:resource" operationName="Microsoft.*Gateway Down"
| table _time ResourceId metricName total average
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.13.5_cloud_network_azure_expr_5"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `azure:monitor:resource` in `index=aws` to detect cloud network azure expressroute gateway down. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Azure portal Metrics explorer for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `ResourceId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_13_5_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud networking logs via provider TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud network azure expressroute gateway down so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
